decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design & Access Statement (dated October 2016), EX01, EX02, EX03, EX04, EX05, EX06, Flood Risk Assessment, D101 Rev A, D102, D103, D104 Rev A, D105 Rev A, D106 Rev A, D107, Received: 27/10/2016) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
description: Erection of a ground floor rear extension a 3-storey brick extension to rear of existing side elevation and new tiled hip roof over second floor level brick extension to side, with two new roofwindows added to existing roofscape.
